thread:
mike: Customer support flagged a double-charge when a streaming toolcall is resumed after truncation + failover. Short repro below.

anya: Outline: client streams -> node1 writes provisional row for prefix -> truncation triggers and session reconnects -> router sends to node2 which doesn't see provisional -> node2 writes another provisional/confirm -> ledger shows both.

leo: Quick mitigation idea: global small index in redis keyed by (acct, toolcall_id || prefix_hash) using SETNX + TTL(90s). If SETNX fails, link to canonical prov id and do not emit a new provisional ledger row.

mike: Also propagate header `X-Resume-Prov: <prov_id>` from router when available so fast-path stitching works without redis hop. Keep redis as fallback for evictions/canary swaps.

anya: Console change: add toggle "include provisional" and a small "prov vs conf delta" metric per-customer for support. Internal debug API `/internal/billing/trace?prov=...` returning ids and token counts (no prompt text).

billing-bot: note: billing aggregation must dedupe using canonical_prov_id; creating internal ticket.

leo: Action items: Ill prototype SETNX pattern, Mike will add router header plumbing, Anya will mock console panel and runbook.

mike: I'll also add a reconciliation job to collapse orphan provisionals older than TTL and emit alerts when net delta > threshold.

anya: Security: traces must not include prompt contents or raw PII; only session hashes and counts.

mike: Filing ticket now. Short follow-ups welcome.
